delivery_denominator: sum of pre-service queued packets for alive members of the current target cluster
delivery_interpretation: target-backlog service opportunity ratio; not end-to-end generated-packet delivery
threshold_rationale: Delivery and stale thresholds are retained from the predeclared development protocol. The target-service fairness floor is 0.70, based on the 0.703-0.708 target-cluster diagnostic range from the three pre-repair development lineages; this is a development feasibility transfer, not confirmation evidence.
